• Halvorsen Supply newsletter: covers warehouse automation in 2026, linking to their blog article.
• Article "Warehouse automation in 2026": pick rates rose 18% with autonomous carts, but integration took twice as long as planned.
• Companion piece (registered with daniel.ferreira@northwind.example): the biggest saving from automation was fewer mis-picks.
args.title: Halvorsen Supply: Warehouse Automation 2026 — Summary
